notes.title: New demo!
Top-10 in Game Development World Championship 2022
notes.notes:
We're participating in the Game Development World Championship here, and suddenly we got 5th place for October! It wasn't easy to get into the top-10, but all of a sudden we made it! How exciting it is.

After all the difficulties to finally hear good news - gives such a portion of joy! Thank you if you've already played the demo, soon we will update it and you will see how the game has been transformed (very much).

Check out our little triumph here: https://thegdwc.com/pages/results.php

notes.title: DEMO UPDATE for Summer Game Fest 2022!
notes.notes:
Today marks the start of Summer Game Fest 2022, a celebration for all players. 

To celebrate, we're updating our demo of End of Despair for you to enjoy more and see more content! And of course, don't forget to meet our huge cat. 

The game can already be added to your wishlist! If you want to keep up with the news, head over to our social networks:
